invasions.log.beachhead_created.en: {event} establishes a {marker} beachhead at {space} and lands {count} units.

invasions.log.beachhead_removed.en: The beachhead at {space} {reason}; remove its marker.

invasions.log.declared_complete.zh-CN: 盟军宣布本局不再进行登陆；剩余可转换登陆牌此后可作为普通增援事件使用。
invasions.log.declared_complete.en: The Allies declare that no further invasions will be made; remaining convertible invasion cards may now be used as ordinary reinforcement events.

invasions.log.deploy.zh-CN: 按普通增援流程部署登陆部队。
invasions.log.deploy.en: Deploy the invasion units using the normal reinforcement procedure.

invasions.log.pacific.zh-CN: {pieces}由预备箱调往太平洋战区并移出游戏。
invasions.log.pacific.en: {pieces} move from the Reserve Box to the Pacific theater and are removed from the game.

invasions.log.reserve_return.zh-CN: {piece}在盟军行动结束后进入盟军预备箱，并恢复为满编。
invasions.log.reserve_return.en: {piece} enters the Allied Reserve Box at the end of the Allied action and returns to full strength.

orders.log.stand_fast_payment.zh-CN: 在{space}忽略{order}：支付{cost} VP，轴心国VP{delta}，当前{vp}。
orders.log.stand_fast_payment.en: Ignoring {order} at {space} costs {cost} VP: Axis VP {delta}; now {vp}.

neutrals.log.declare_war_penalty.en: The Axis declares war on {country}: VP -{penalty}, now {vp}.

neutrals.log.turkey_rp.zh-CN: 土耳其获得本回合固定2点补员点，由{side}使用。
neutrals.log.turkey_rp.en: Turkey receives a fixed 2 RP this turn, spent by {side}.

neutrals.log.vichy.zh-CN: 维希法国参战；双方此后可进入维希法国及法属北非。
neutrals.log.vichy.en: Vichy France enters the war; both sides may now enter Vichy France and French North Africa.

replacements.log.voluntary_elimination.zh-CN: 盟军自愿消灭{piece}；该单位将在 Turn {turn} 进入被消灭区。
replacements.log.voluntary_elimination.en: The Allies voluntarily eliminate {piece}; it enters the Eliminated Units Box in Turn {turn}.

replacements.log.wehrkreis.zh-CN: 德国军区惩罚：{count} 个军区失控和/或断补，德国补员点减少 {points}。
replacements.log.wehrkreis.en: Wehrkreis penalty: {count} districts are uncontrolled and/or out of supply; German RP is reduced by {points}.

replacements.log.axis_variant_rp.zh-CN: 德国军备：本回合德国补员点 +{points}。
replacements.log.axis_variant_rp.en: German armaments: +{points} German RP this turn.
